Name: Castle
Label: CASTLE
Description: Appears next to a jobless unit when he proclaims himself king. The kingdom name floats above it. (No drawing yet: placeholder square.)

Name: House
Label: HOUSE
Description: Each family has a house where they sleep (gathered by family), eat together and talk about rumors or how their day went. (No drawing yet.)

Name: Theater
Label: PLAY
Description: Needs a blacksmith and 2 or more bards. Plays are held around it. (No drawing yet.)

Name: Coliseum
Label: ARENA
Description: Needs 4 or more knights and a blacksmith. Works like the theater, but with knights. (No drawing yet.)

Name: Kingdom chest
Description: Appears right next to the castle when a kingdom is made. Everyone puts what belongs to the kingdom here. Click it to see what is inside. It can be raided.

Name: Farm
Label: FARM
Description: Farmers work next to a farm and make the full amount of food. Without a farm they only work the open ground, which is slower. The kingdom builds one farm for every 3 farmers when it has the wood, and a blacksmith builds it. (No drawing yet: placeholder.)

Name: Torch
Description: Built by a blacksmith. Gives light (the add/color-dodge layer mode) at dusk and at night. Kingdoms put torches at the corners of the castle, in front of the theater and the coliseum, and next to some houses. (No drawing yet: placeholder flame.)

Name: Wall
Description: Blacksmiths use spare wood of the kingdom to build walls along the border, one piece at a time. A few gaps (gates) stay open so units can still walk in and out. Walls have hearts, can be damaged in wars and are repaired by blacksmiths. (No drawing yet: placeholder stone block.)

Name: Tree
Description: Scattered everywhere and regrows randomly across the map. Turns 50% see-through when a unit stands behind it.

Name: Tombstone
Label: RIP
Description: Appears where a unit died and stays for 1 day, then fades softly. Family gathers around it. (No drawing yet.)

Name: Food
Description: Kingdom food. Farmers and hunters bring it, everyone eats it. Each point fills 3 hunger.

Name: Wood
Description: Brought by axemen. Used to build structures.

Name: Gold
Description: Brought by merchants. Tyrant kings love it. Used to build bigger structures.
